name: Visual Eulogy
source:
In a world devastated by VN, one NEET gets tasked with creating a visual novel of his own. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140727073955/http://www.weeaboo.nl/2013/04/review-nanoreno-2013-part-2/]weeaboo.nl[/url]]
translation:
在一個被視覺小說摧毀的世界裡，一名家裡蹲接到任務，要製作一部屬於自己的視覺小說。

［來自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140727073955/http://www.weeaboo.nl/2013/04/review-nanoreno-2013-part-2/]weeaboo.nl[/url]］
